items.title: 8.5.3 How to Protect Your Intellectual Property (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5.3 (PDF 203); copyright arising automatically is general knowledge (flagged); MCQ 10.

items: Patents: agar aap koi nayi cheez ijad karein to Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO Pakistan) ke zariye patent ki darkhwast (apply) dein.
Trademarks: apne brand ka naam, logo ya slogan trademark ke taur par register karwayein ta ke doosre use istemal na kar sakein.
Copyrights: apne takhleeqi kaam (creative works) ko munasib idare (authority) ke paas register karwa kar un ki hifazat yaqeeni banayein.
Trade Secrets: qeemti karobari maloomat raaz (confidential) rakhein aur un ki hifazat ke liye qanooni muahide (legal agreements) istemal karein.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: Pakistan samait kai mulkon mein copyright kaam bante hi khud ba khud mil jata hai; registration zaroori nahi magar milkiyat ka mazboot saboot deti hai. Pakistan mein copyright, patent aur trademark teeno IPO Pakistan ke paas register hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Company apna trade secret kaise mehfooz rakh sakti hai? (MCQ 10)
blocks.explanation: (c) By keeping the information confidential and using legal agreements. IPO mein register karna, trademark lena ya journal mein chhapna maloomat ko zahir kar dega, aur zahir hone ke baad woh raaz nahi rehti. (Kitab ki answer key (b) deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khata.)

items: Patent aur trademark: IPO Pakistan mein register; copyright: munasib idare mein register.
Trade secret: raaz rakhein aur legal agreements istemal karein.
